title: Fractions to Decimals, Rounding and Comparing
topic: Conversion of Fractions to Decimals and Rounding
subject: Mathematics

questions.question: Convert 5/6 to a decimal correct to 2 decimal places.
questions.explanation: 5/6 = 5 divided by 6 = 0.8333... The third decimal digit is 3 (less than 5), so we round down to 0.83

questions.question: Which of the following fractions is closest to 1 whole?
questions.explanation: Convert each to decimal: 7/8 = 0.875, 5/6 = 0.833, 4/5 = 0.8, 3/4 = 0.75. Since 0.875 is the largest and nearest to 1, the answer is 7/8.

questions.question: Convert 7/12 to a decimal correct to 2 decimal places.
questions.explanation: 7/12 = 7 divided by 12 = 0.5833... The third decimal digit is 3 (less than 5), so we round down to 0.58

questions.question: Which of these fractions is closest to 1 whole?
questions.explanation: Convert each: 5/9 = 0.556, 3/5 = 0.6, 7/10 = 0.7, 11/12 = 0.917. Since 0.917 is closest to 1, the answer is 11/12.

questions.question: Convert 2/9 to a decimal correct to 3 decimal places.
questions.explanation: 2/9 = 2 divided by 9 = 0.2222... The fourth decimal digit is 2 (less than 5), so we round down to 0.222

questions.question: What is 0.4567 rounded to 2 decimal places?
questions.explanation: Look at the third decimal digit which is 6 (5 or more), so we round up the second decimal digit. 0.4567 rounds to 0.46

questions.question: Which of these fractions is the furthest from 1 whole?
questions.explanation: Convert each: 2/3 = 0.667, 7/8 = 0.875, 9/10 = 0.9, 5/6 = 0.833. Since 0.667 is the smallest and furthest from 1, the answer is 2/3.

questions.question: Convert 5/11 to a decimal correct to 2 decimal places.
questions.explanation: 5/11 = 5 divided by 11 = 0.4545... The third decimal digit is 4 (less than 5), so we round down to 0.45
